design_name: Safe neighborhood transfer for OOD exploration
status: post-result-method-development; frozen before new signal-anatomy outputs
history: The fixed-ranking OBELiX direction, the null frozen sequential campaign, and the superiority of the random reference were known before this design. Consequently, no OBELiX result from this extension can be called confirmatory. The purpose is to diagnose failure modes, develop safe transfer policies, and define an independent validation program.
scientific_question: Can a neighboring source task improve OOD exploration after separating source relevance, target-model exploitation, uncertainty, and candidate-space coverage?
claim_hierarchy: source signal exists on target labels
source signal is complementary to a target-only model
target-only acquisition is valid relative to random acquisition
source-aware acquisition improves the same valid target-only policy
the improvement survives negative-transfer controls and an independent target
selected experiments expose a reproducible scientific relation rather than only a high target value

diagnostics: initial-label source credibility and its relation to realized source utility
stage_1_signal_anatomy.claim_guard: All target outcomes have already been inspected indirectly through prior analyses. These outputs are mechanism-finding diagnostics, not a new positive OOD claim.

stage_2_policy_validity_gate.rule: A target-only acquisition family must first beat uniform random acquisition before any source-prior increment is interpreted.
candidate_target_only_policies: adaptive portfolio over mean, diversity, and random policies
minimum_evidence: paired interval above zero experiments saved versus random
positive effect in at least 60 percent of campaigns
no materially worse censoring than random
robust direction across at least two surrogate families

priority_methods.name: cross-validated residual shrinkage
priority_methods.description: Use the source prediction as an offset or residual covariate with a coefficient estimated only from target-training folds and shrunk continuously to zero.

priority_methods.name: credibility-weighted rank fusion
priority_methods.description: Estimate source direction and weight from initial target labels; fuse target and source ranks rather than raw, differently scaled properties; allow a zero-weight fallback.

priority_methods.name: safe acquisition portfolio
priority_methods.description: Adaptively weight target-only, source-aware, diversity, and uniform-random policies using observed online rewards so that a harmful prior can be abandoned.

priority_methods.name: novelty-gated borrowing
priority_methods.description: Use the source prior only where target-space coverage is poor and the source signal is locally credible; otherwise use the validated target-only policy.

negative_transfer_controls: source-weight trace showing collapse toward zero for irrelevant sources

methods: multi-information-source Gaussian process with learned task-specific means and scales
non-negative task covariance with partial source-target co-location
task-conditioned shared representation with leave-one-task-out validation
meta-learned acquisition function across multiple source-target campaigns
stage_4_higher_complexity_methods.entry_rule: Attempt only after the safe rank/residual baselines and policy-validity gate; otherwise model complexity is not scientifically identifiable.

independent_validation.required_positive_test: a new outcome-blind target or prospective campaign not used to design or select the method
independent_validation.unit: campaign, article, time block, or canonical composition rather than measurement row

new_science_endpoint.requirement: A high-value hit alone is not new science.
evidence: a source-informed hypothesis specified before revealing the target result
a reproducible composition-family, condition, or mechanism-level contrast
a matched negative control or intervention
confirmation in an independent experiment or dataset

claim_guard: The next paper may claim safer or more effective neighborhood transfer only after a target-only policy passes the random gate and the source increment survives independent validation. It may claim new scientific insight only after a source-informed hypothesis is independently confirmed.
